feat(b4-award-readiness): consolidated W23-W25 nine-stage reassessment, end-to-end demo integration, Control Room polish, and final documentation reconciliation

WORK-B4-23: final evidence-based nine-stage DevSecOps reassessment against the
current October 2026 official criterion (touching counts, with stricter internal
attribution preserved); judge-readable matrix at docs/DEVSECOPS_STAGES.md;
recommendation 4 core YES (Plan, Verify, Secure, Govern) + 4 qualified YES with
mandatory disclosures (Create, Package, Configure, Monitor) + Release NO;
Master Plan sections 2/4.7.6/7/13 synchronized.

WORK-B4-24: docs/DEMO_SCRIPT.md rewritten as the evidence-labeled end-to-end
demonstration path (operator-initiated Supervised chain, never narrated as
single-trigger autonomous); Control Room targeted improvements: first-screen
product explainer, per-section recorded observation timestamps in the header,
tab/tablist/tabpanel ARIA landmarks, meta description, maintained aria-selected;
real-browser validated (all five tabs render, graph/what-if/evidence
interactions verified, zero console errors, zero runtime network fetches beyond
the two static files, Lighthouse accessibility/best-practices/SEO 100); live
read-only evidence regenerated 2026-10-21T15:15Z (pages publication
VERIFIED_LIVE_SERVED across all 5 levels; resurrection monitoring
HISTORICAL_RECEIPT_UNVERIFIED / MECHANISM_PRESENT, 12 invariants); 12-point
canonical Pages feasibility study completed (Master Plan 10.3): deployment
feasible at \.00 but public accessibility requires a Maintainer
pages_access_level change unavailable to the operator - NO deployment
attempted, NO CI change, local file:// Control Room remains the verified
fallback.

WORK-B4-25: README fully rewritten product-first (stale claims removed:
no-mutation-command contradiction, wrong session emphasis, obsolete test
counts; final suite 540; guarded retire-pages --execute accurately described);
DOC-01..DOC-10 reconciled (launcher Python floor aligned to 3.12 matching
pyproject); final 10-scene 174 s video runbook with complete English
voice-over and subtitles (Master Plan 11.2); final Devpost packet (Section 13);
5-image screenshot packet (Section 12); new Turkish operator filming and
submission guide docs/OPERATOR_FILMING_GUIDE.md; evidence matrix and handoff
synchronized.

Verification: 540 tests passed, ruff clean, 40/40 network-free CI safety
assertions, CLI smoke tests positive and negative (fail-closed refusals:
operator-trust gate, OFFLINE_PUBLICATION_REFUSED). Zero personal spend; no
destructive operation, no Pages DELETE, no public UI hosting, no video capture,
no Devpost submission. Post-push pipeline/observer verification recorded in
the completion report per the immutable provenance contract.
